docs.title: TACTIC Docs
docs.text:
Welcome to the Magic Lantern Workbench TACTIC documentation. The documentation is divided into the following books:

  • Quick Start - get TACTIC, set up your first project and run a workflow
  • Setup - configure projects, search types, workflow and access rules
  • System Administration - install, deploy, back up and maintain a TACTIC server
  • Developer - client API, scripting and development environment
